findings.category: element_overlap (sidebar scrolls under the header on short categories)
findings.state_artifact: C-r4/D-07-menu-cat-sandwichs-4.png, D-08-menu-cat-galette-2.png, D-10, D-11, D-12, D-13, D-16
findings.evidence: This is a residual of CW-004, which is fixed for long lists (D-05, D-09, D-14 show 'CATÉGORIES' and '✦ Tout 39' fully below the header). On categories with a single row of cards, after the scroll needed to see the cards (scrollY 371), the sidebar is no longer sticky. D-07: the active 'Sandwichs' pill, 'Tout' and the 'CATÉGORIES' heading are hidden under the translucent header, and the first visible row is 'Galette' at y≈144. D-08: the top edge of the active 'Galette' pill is cut by the header line (y 132). Cause: styles-v2.css:203-207 '.lc-menu-side { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--entete-h…) + 20px); align-self: start; }' inside .lc-menu-layout. When the card column is shorter than the sidebar, the grid row equals the sidebar height, so sticky has no room to hold it.
findings.fix_hint: Give .lc-menu-layout (or the card column) min-height: calc(100vh - var(--entete-h)) on ≥1024px, or make the sidebar max-height: calc(100vh - var(--entete-h) - 40px) with its own overflow.
